[[The Stonehart]] is a [[unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Brohn Stoneheart]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Healing Prayers]])
:[[Healing Prayers]] +1 (20% chance while using skills)
:Halves skill recharge of Healing Prayers [[spell]]s (20% chance)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Divine Symbol (loop)]] with a slight purple tint dissimilar to any [[dye]]s.

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated, as it effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Master of My Domain" and "Forget Me Not".
